caption: Most progress pics are set up to fail. Here's how to take one that actually shows your gains 📌 #gymtok #progresspics #fitnesstips #gymprogress #gainlapse

slides.headline: How to take a progress pic that [[actually shows gains]]

slides.heading: Same spot every time
slides.body:
Same mirror, same distance.

Put a piece of tape on the floor where your feet go.

slides.heading: Same light, same time of day
slides.body:
Lighting changes how you look more than a month of training.

Morning, before you eat, same lights on.

slides.heading: Same pose, no flexing
slides.body:
Relaxed, front and side.

Flex in one and not the other and the comparison is useless.

slides.heading:
Once a week.
Not every day.
slides.body:
Pick a photo day and stick to it.

Then compare week 1 to week 12, not today to yesterday.

slides.heading:
So we built
[[an app for this]]
slides.body: A faint overlay of last week's photo lines up every shot. Then it builds your timelapse.

slides.headline: Search [[Gainlapse]] on the App Store
slides.body: Follow for more. Take your week 1 photo today.
